title: v0 Factor Research Workflow for A-share Stable Factor Group + Strategy
goal: Use AKQuant 0.3.64 to find: (1) the best factor research workflow, (2) the most stable factor group across A-share regimes, (3) the most stable strategy that exploits that factor group.

Stage 1_baseline.name: Single-factor trend-following baseline
Stage 1_baseline.input: v2 panel (420 cols), 393 unique factors after dedup

Stage 2_regime_stability.name: Cross-regime single-factor stability
Stage 2_regime_stability.method: Slice v3 raw_results per (factor, rebal) by regime: bull (idx in bull_legs), bear (idx in bear_legs), sideways (between legs). Compute stability metric: stability = mean(closed_ret) - stdev(closed_ret) / max_dd. Rank factors by stability > +0 AND mean > +1% across regimes.
Stage 2_regime_stability.output: regime_stability.json (per-factor × regime closed_ret + composite stability score)

Stage 3_multi_factor_composite.name: Top-N stable factors composite ranking
Stage 3_multi_factor_composite.method: Use bull_composite_topk_backtest.py pipeline (multi-symbol, cross-section rank). Replace 6-factor BULL_FACTORS with top-N from Stage 2 (N=3,5,7,10). Test each composite in 10 bull legs.
Stage 3_multi_factor_composite.output: per-N per-leg composite return + sharpe + MDD

Stage 4_multi_symbol_topk.name: Multi-symbol top-K + rebal sweep
Stage 4_multi_symbol_topk.method: Use bull_composite pipeline. Sweep top_k={5,10,15,20,30} × rebal={5,10,20,40}. Each backtest: closed_only_return + sharpe + MDD + commission.

Stage 5_oos_validation.name: Out-of-sample validation + risk controls
Stage 5_oos_validation.method: Time-series split: train 2010-2018, val 2019-2021, OOS 2022-2025. Add cost sensitivity: commission={0,15,25,40} bps × slippage={0,5,10} bps. Test MDD cap (e.g., 20%) with kill-switch logic.

single_variable_discipline.rule: Each Stage changes ONLY ONE variable from prior Stage. No multi-variable tuning.
single_variable_discipline.rollback: Each Stage writes artefacts to evidence/<stage>_<ts>/. If Stage N+1 fails, the prior Stage artefacts are the snapshot.
single_variable_discipline.frozen_code: panel_loader.py, bull_composite_topk_backtest.py are FROZEN. Stage 3/4 only ADD new scripts.

stability_metric_definition.intuition: Positive mean (alpha exists) AND low stdev/MDD (stable across regimes) -> high score

deliverable.code: examples/ subdir with Stage 2-5 scripts (Stage 1 = existing sweep_v3_*)
